expectations.assertion: Renders the page chrome (layout, title, controls) immediately rather than waiting on the data
expectations.reason: The page title 'Usage – Last 30 Days' and layout structure render unconditionally before any data fetch completes; only the table conditionally shows skeleton or data.

expectations.assertion: Uses a pixel-matched skeleton for the table rows, not a generic spinner or a blank area
expectations.reason: LoadingTable renders a structurally identical skeleton with header and 10 placeholder rows matching the real table's columns and layout.

expectations.assertion: Transitions the loaded data in by blur (a short fade/blur arrival) instead of an abrupt pop
expectations.reason: UsageTable uses `animate-in fade-in duration-500` to provide a smooth 500ms fade transition rather than an abrupt appearance.

expectations.assertion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion and announces the loading state accessibly (role=status or equivalent)
expectations.reason: The transcript contains no implementation of prefers-reduced-motion media queries or accessibility attributes like role='status'/aria-live on the loading state or skeleton elements.
